rules-responsible.title: Who's responsible?

config.intro: You own the station. What do the rules say?

cases.situation: A visiting amateur operates your station. Who's responsible?
cases.why: The owner and the control operator share responsibility.

cases.situation: Your unlicensed teenager uses the radio while you're out.
cases.why: Without a certificate they need your supervision and presence.

cases.situation: A friend with no certificate talks on the air with you beside them, supervising.
cases.why: Allowed under supervision and in the presence of a qualified operator.

cases.situation: Does the station need a control operator when you're only listening?
cases.why: A control operator is needed whenever the station transmits.

rules-responsible.success: Owner and control operator share it; unqualified people only with a qualified operator present.
